captions.detailed: This 3D model consists of two separate hemispherical dome-shaped shells designed to fit together as a two-part mold. The first dome has a slightly raised, thin circular lip along its bottom rim, while the second dome has a matching hollowed profile to receive the lip. Both parts feature smooth, rounded outer surfaces with uniform wall thickness and flat, open circular bases.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric, two-part spherical or egg-shaped mold in OpenSCAD. The script should generate a 'base' half with a click-together lip and a 'top' half, featuring adjustable parameters for inner radius, vertical scaling factor, shell thickness, vent hole size, and lip height.
captions.factory: The script uses nested CSG operations to construct the mold halves. The 'lip' module is created by intersecting a scaled hollow sphere with a cube to isolate the joint profile. The 'holder' (base) module combines this lip with a hollowed-out hemisphere using boolean differences between scaled spheres and a cutting cube. The 'holderhead' (top) module is built from another hollowed hemisphere, optionally subtracted by a thin central cylinder to form a vent hole.
